epics.title: Basic Calculation Functionality
epics.description: Implement basic arithmetic operations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. This feature is essential for users to perform simple calculations conveniently on their smartphones.

user_stories.title: Perform Addition
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to add two numbers so that I can quickly calculate their sum.
acceptance_criteria: The calculator allows the user to input two numbers.
The result of the addition is displayed correctly.

user_stories.title: Perform Subtraction
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to subtract one number from another so that I can find the difference.
acceptance_criteria: The calculator allows the user to input two numbers.
The result of the subtraction is displayed correctly.

user_stories.title: Perform Multiplication
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to multiply two numbers so that I can obtain their product.
acceptance_criteria: The calculator allows the user to input two numbers.
The result of the multiplication is displayed correctly.

user_stories.title: Perform Division
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to divide one number by another so that I can calculate the quotient.
acceptance_criteria: The calculator allows the user to input two numbers.
The result of the division is displayed correctly, and division by zero is handled appropriately.

epics.title: User Interface Design
epics.description: Create a simple and intuitive user interface that allows users to easily input numbers and select operations. A user-friendly interface is vital for ensuring a positive user experience.

user_stories.title: Input Numbers
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to easily input numbers so that I can perform calculations without frustration.
acceptance_criteria: The app includes a numeric keypad for input.
The numeric keypad is responsive and allows for easy number entry.

user_stories.title: Select Operations
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to select basic arithmetic operations so that I can perform calculations effortlessly.
acceptance_criteria: The app displays clearly labeled buttons for each arithmetic operation.
Users can tap the operation button after entering the numbers to perform the calculation.

user_stories.title: Display Results
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to see the calculation results clearly so that I can verify my answers.
acceptance_criteria: The result of the calculation is displayed prominently on the screen.
The display updates immediately after the user performs a calculation.
